Capped recall ($R\_cap@k$) is defined as: 
$$R\_cap@k= \frac{1}{|Q|} \sum_{i=1}^{|Q|} \frac{|\max_k(A_i) \cap A^\star_i|}{\min(k,|A^\star_i|)}$$ 
where $Q$ is the set of queries, $A^\star_i$ is the set of relevant documents for the $i$-th query, and $A_i$ is a scored list of documents provided by the model from which the top $k$ are extracted [407, 409].
